Description: Create a palm-sized globe of light at a targeted point in space. The globe gives off light to a 30 radius. It gives off dim light for another 30 foot radius. As an action or as part of their movement, the caster can move the globe up to 30 feet per round.

Place a recording of your voice onto a physical object or location that will repeat it if activated with faez, or a command word. The recording can be no longer than 30 seconds. Escalation: Add an additional year of duration and 30 seconds for 1 FP. Or cast the spell at 5 FP to make it permanent and 2 minutes.

Caster can see residue left by faez use up to 20 feet away. Left over magic will generally only stick around for a short time depending on the level of the spell. Residue will remain for 10 minutes per Faez Point spent. Escalation: The caster can see slight color differences that show the different elements or spell type for 2 additional FP.
Protect yourself from natural weather phenomena (cold, rain, wind, heat) that are not dangerous (hurricanes, sand storm, heat wave, deep frost, tornado, etc.).

Unless someone is actively looking for you, the player can move through crowded public spaces without being noticed. Only works if there are other people around. If someone is actively looking for you, any perception checks are at disadvantage. If you are making a scene (casting a spell, or other physical action) it will ruin the effect.
Target can see in the dark up to 60 feet normally and another 30ft in dim light. Can only see in black and white. Escalate: For 1 FP , increase range by 30 feet and duration by 1 hour
Create a small flame on your hand or other body part without causing injury to oneself. Can use for light, starting small fires, or cause pain but no damage to another target.
Caster selects up to 5 simultaneously touched items during casting. Those items’ colors change to any other color on the visible spectrum the caster wishes for the duration of the spell.

Take a small simple item less than 5lbs and no larger than a 1ft cube and transform it into another small simple item of a similar size (ex. - change a toothbrush into a sharp knife). The spell cannot dramatically change the value (i.e. - no corn to gold, but the rocks might look like gold). The item must be in your possession. The transformation might introduce long term problems with the items. Escalation: Can spend 1 point to increase the weight by 5lbs and the size by 0.5ft cube

Shoot a 15 ft spray of flame in an 45 degree arc dealing 1d6 fire damage (Dex save for half). At level 6, 9, 12, and 15 damage increases by 1d6 damage. Escalation: Can spend 1 point to increase damage by another 1d6 (Max 2)
Give fire resistance. Escalation: Can spend 1 additional point to give to another target

The caster quickly alters the size and fit of the touched individual’s clothing as if they had been altered by a high-end tailor. Escalation: Can spend 1 additional point to cause the touched clothing to restrain their wearer. Upon cast, the wearer makes a STR saving throw. On a success, they rip their clothing in a way that allows free movement. On a failure, they are restrained. At the end of each of their turns, they can make another STR saving throw or they can make a DEX saving throw. If they are successful on the DEX saving throw, they are able to wiggle out of their restraining clothing. The duration decreases to 10 rounds.
Flames encase casters hands and they can make melee attacks for normal punch damage plus 1d8 fire damage. Escalation: Can spend 1 FP to increase damage by 1d8 (Max 1 increase).

Shoot 3 rays from your hand. Must hit a target with a ranged spell attack to succeed. Each ray deals 2d8 damage. Escalation: Can spend 1 additional point to add another ray and increase range by 20 feet (Max 2 increase).

For the duration of the spell, the caster can take 1 additional action per turn. They also take 1d6 fire damage that cannot be resisted at the end of each of their turns during the spell’s duration. After the spell is over they gain a level of exhaustion for 5 rounds.

Target enemy must make a DC save or become enbrittled for five rounds. Being enbrittled means the target cannot prevent damage, or be healed during the duration, and all attacks against the target have their critical range increased by 3. On a successful save, all attacks against target for the next round are at advantage.
Repair small superficial or visible wounds like bruising or small cuts.
Roll a 1d8 to add to a skill check or ability check. Cannot cast multiple of the same attribute or skill. Can cast multiple spells of different abilities or skills on the same person.

Lob a dirty water bulb with a ranged attack that if it hits the target, deals 1d6 damage and the target loses their reaction until the end of your next turn. At level 6, 9, 12, and 15, increase the number of targets by 1. Escalation: Can spend 1 point to increase the number of targets by 1 (Max 2)

When given an opportunity attack, or hit by a damaging attack, the caster can use their reaction to deliver a ranged attack of a faez-charged slap dealing 1d6 water damage. At level 6, 9, 12, and 15, increase the damage by 1d6.
Get a swim speed equal to your land speed. Escalation: Can spend 1 point to increase swim speed by 20 feet
Heal target 1d8 damage. Escalation: Can spend 1 point to increase healing by 1d8 (Max 3)
Heal target 1d6 damage. Escalation: Can spend 1 point to increase healing by 1d6 (Max 3)

When given an opportunity attack, or hit by a damaging attack (within 15ft), or the target fails a spell save (within 15ft), the caster can use their reaction to hit them with the Cursed Momentum spell. Target must make a DC STR Save or have their movement reduced by 50% for 2 rounds and take 1d8 water damage. If the target makes a save, they only take damage. Escalation: Can spend 1 additional point to change to loss of movement and 2d8 damage (Max 2)
Increase AC by 2 and give 10 temporary hit points. Escalation: Can spend 1 additional point to give to an additional target

While this spell is active, player can cast spells as a reaction that normally require an action or bonus action. They can use these spells either as an opportunity attack, if they are damaged by an attack (max 15ft range), or an enemy fails their spell save (max 15ft range). The player also heals 1d4 damage at the end of each of their turns during the duration. Players still have to meet requirements for a reaction to use it.
When hit by an attack, gain resistance to that attack (50% damage down) and move up to 15 feet.

Send a 30 word or less message to someone known by the caster. Must know the general location of the target and cannot be blocked by a sealed container. The message must be spoken which is transported to the other person through the air and into their ear.

Caster creates a 30-foot area breeze centered on a target until dismissed for up to one hour. This can be as light as the caster wants or can be powerful enough to blow around items under a weight of 0.5 pound.

Call up winds to batter a large or smaller target. The target loses their bonus action, movement is halved, and have to make an DC STR Save or be knocked prone. Any intimidation skill checks versus this opponent are made at advantage for 1 hour afterwards.

Shoot a dart of compacted wind at a target to deal 1d10 damage upon hit (ranged attack). At level 6, 9, 12, and 15, increase the number of wind dart targets by 1. Escalation: Can spend 1 point to increase the number of targets by 1 (Max 2).
Jump triple normal jumping distance
Target make a DC STR Save or take 3d6 + Air FE damage and be knocked prone, save reduces the damage by half. Escalation: Spend 1 FP to increase damage by 1d6.
Caster gains 4 movement actions this round.

Move all willing and/or friendly targets up to 10 feet then deal 4d8 damage to all targets in a 20’ by 20’ area from materials swept up in squall level winds battering the targets. Dex save for half. Escalation: Can spend 1 additional point to increase damage by 2d8 (Max 1)

Increase speed by 20 feet and create a 10 ft radius field of whirling debris around the caster. Anyone caught in the debris, entering the debris, or starting its turn in the field takes 3d10 damage unless they make a DEX save (save takes half damage). Caster does not provoke opportunity attacks while the spell is active. Escalation: Can spend 1 additional point to increase damage by 2d10 (Max 1)

You call a dangerous storm of crashing lightning and battering winds to a 20- foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range. Each creature in the cylinder must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 5d10 lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Each round, if one of the damage die is a 10, each creature in the cylinder must make a Strength saving throw. A creature is knocked prone on a failed save. Escalation: Can spend 1 additional point to increase damage by 2d10 (Max 1)

Until the end of your next turn, you have resistance against bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage by non-magical weapon attacks. Escalation: Can spend 1 point to make Minor Warding an Aura with a duration of 1 hour
Repair a simple object or machine (sewing machine, bicycle, etc.)

Shoot a dense rock at a target dealing 1d6 damage upon hit (ranged attack); Critical range for this spell is lower by 1. At level 6, 9, 12, and 15 increase the number of targets by 1. Escalation: Can spend 1 point to increase number of targets by 1 (Max 2)
Increase AC by 2

Duration: Until long rest, or ward is consumed
Description: Caster gains +4 AC versus bullets, and the first time they are damaged by a bullet, they take no damage and the ward is consumed.

Using common materials like mud, dirt, broken chairs, etc. create a homunculus that has 5 hit points, weights 20 lbs, and is 1 foot tall. The homunculus is psychically connected to the caster and can follow mental orders for up to 200 feet. The homunculus can speak for the caster, carry small objects less than 2 lbs, be used as a scout, or whatever the caster can think of. It cannot easily deal damage. Escalation: Can spend 1 additional point to increase duration by 1 hour.

Shoot a dense ball of earthen magic at the target dealing 5d6 damage upon hit with a ranged attack. Target must make a CON save or be stunned for 1 round. Escalation: Can spend 1 additional point to increase damage by 2d6 (Max 1).
During the duration of the spell, the target can have up to 2 active auras.

You have resistance against bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage by non-magical and magical weapon attacks. Critical attacks against you are treated as non-critical attacks. Critical range for your attacks reduced by 1. Escalation: Can spend 1 additional point to increase duration to 4 hours.
Remember a piece of trivia or fact that you once knew. Cannot be information that you are not consciously aware of or did not intend to remember (vaguely overheard information doesn’t count).
The caster has a flash of insight and suddenly knows one useless fact or one thing that will happen to someone somewhere that will not directly affect the caster.
Reveal elemental information about target item (less than 200 lbs) and other useful arcane information about it’s history. Gain advantage if an Arcane, or other similar knowledge check is required.

Shoot a bolt of force energy at a target dealing 1d6 damage upon hit (ranged attack) and push target back 5 feet. +2 to hit for all force bolt attacks. At level 6, 9, 12, and 15, increase number of targets by 1. Escalation: Can spend 1 point to increase number of targets (Max 3)

Create force pads to quickly climb to a higher elevation, or cross an open span; can reach 30 feet high (maximum 45 degree angle) or 60 feet long; the stones last until the end of the caster’s next round. This spell does not move the player but only provides a way for them to cross a space. Escalation: Can spend 1 point to climb another 20 feet higher or 30 feet longer

For the duration, the target has limited insight into the future and can foresee small shifts in the future. Roll 2 d20s and save the results. At any time, you can replace your or an enemy’s d20 dice roll with one of these saved dice. Can only cast this spell once per day. All additional castings automatically fail. Escalation: Can spend 1 additional point for another d20

Caster creates an invisible wall of force up to 100 square feet in size. The entirety of the wall has to be connected and must not have any holes. It can be bent at 90 degree angles. Upon cast, an outer side of the wall and an inner side of the wall is chosen. Those within 10 feet of the outer side of the wall must roll a STR saving throw or be pushed 10 feet directly away from the wall. If this movement causes impact with a solid surface, that individual is dealt 1d6 physical damage. Those within 10 feet of the inner side of the wall can choose to be pushed 10 feet directly away from the wall; this movement does not cause damage. This wall dissipates on the beginning of your next turn. Escalation: Spend 1 FP to increase square footage of the wall by 50ft

All creatures caught in the force wave take 5d6 damage. All creatures must make a STR save or be pushed back 10 feet and knocked prone. Making the save takes half damage but is not pushed or knocked prone. Escalation: Can spend 1 additional point to increase damage by 2d6 and pushed back 5 more feet (Max 1)

While the spell is active caster rolls advantage on all attacks, checks, and saving throws. They do not provoke opportunity attacks and reroll all 1s for attacks, checks, and damage. The caster can also spend 1 FP while the spell is active to cast a spell that normally requires an action as a bonus action.

Create a divining apparatus out of materials at hand. A stick on a string, a floating bottle, etc. As you imbue the materials with faez, describe or name an object or creature familiar to you. The apparatus points you unerringly to the object or creature as long as it is within 1,000 feet of you. Escalation: Can spend 1 additional point to increase distance the apparatus can pick up to 2,500 feet.
Give yourself advantage versus poisons, the ability to eat any disgusting non-dangerous foods without showing revulsion, and keep yourself from vomiting (if you so choose).

Lob an acid blob at target dealing 1d6 upon hit (ranged attack); target takes an additional 1d6 damage the following turn unless they use a bonus action (or action) to clean off the acid. Escalation: Can spend 1 point to increase initial damage by another 1d6

When given an opportunity attack, or damaged by an enemy (range 15ft), or an enemy fails a spell save (range 15ft), the caster may hit the target with an acid jet which deals 5d6 fire damage and reduces their movement by half for the rest of their turn.
With a successful melee hit, target takes 1d6 electricity damage. They must roll a DC CON save or drop anything they are currently holding.
Target enemy must make a DC CON save or take 1d8 fire damage and then drop the metal, or other material that can hold heat, item in their hands.
In a 30 feet arc, blast electricity for 6d8 electrical damage to anyone in range with half damage on a DC DEX save. Escalation: Can spend 1 additional point increase damage by 2d8 (Max 1)

Lob a fiery rock at a target within range dealing 1d6 fire damage and 1d6 bludgeoning damage. Everyone within 5 feet takes 1d6 fire damage. Escalation: Spend 1 additional faez point to increase damage by 1d6 for all fire damage.
A flaming spear is hurled at the target and upon hit (ranged attack) takes 2d8 fire damage. Escalation: Can spend 1 point to increase damage by 1d8 and range by 50 feet.

A field of 30’ by 30’ grows rocky spikes that pierce flesh and create havoc. Anyone caught in the field must make a DEX save or take 4d6 piercing and 4d6 fire damage (save takes half damage). Anyone moving through the field takes 1d6 fire damage for every 10 feet traveled. The field is difficult terrain for as long as the spell is active. Escalation: Can spend 1 additional point to increase piercing and fire damage by 1d6 (Max 1)

Target must succeed a DC Dex save or have fiery bracelets on their ankles which cause 1d4 fire damage each turn and reduce their speed by half if they fail, or only the reduced speed until the end of their next turn if they save. Target can save at the end of successive rounds.
You jump up to 15 feet without triggering opportunity attacks. Upon landing at your destination, fire erupts around you causing 1d6 fire damage to any adjacent individuals who fail a Dex save.

Target makes a CON save. On a failure, their fingers have the consistency and usefulness of cooked pasta noodles and cannot use their hands for spells or weapons. Target gets another CON save at the end of each of their turns.

Target must make a DC CHA save or become soul scorched. Failure to save takes 6d8 spirit damage and cannot heal for the next 3 rounds. Success takes half damage. Escalation: Spend 1 FP to increase damage by 2d8 (Max 1)
Gain resistance versus cold, ignore difficult terrain if it’s ice or an icy surface, and unarmed attacks can be cold or bludgeoning damage.

For the duration, the willing target is not affected by difficult terrain, or have their speed reduced by any manner. They cannot be paralyzed or restrained by spell effects (physical restraining can still occur). Increase speed by 10 feet. Escalation: Can spend 1 additional point to give to another target

Target enemy is coated in a sheen of glistening ice. They take 1d6 cold damage every turn. If they choose to move (forced movement doesn’t count), the ice hardens around them. For every 10 feet of movement, more ice forms on their body and they take another 1d6 cold damage and must make a DC CON save or become incapacitated. Once incapacitated, they may make a new save at the end of each of their turns. The spell only goes away if concentration is broken or the target is unconscious.

Range: 5 feet radius, or one big plant
Description: Touch any plant or green area to improve growth, or keep it from falling ill if in difficult conditions for the following week. Can only have 1 Green Hands spell active at a time.

Target is surrounded by 10’ radius grasping vines. All creatures in the zone must make a DC DEX save or become immobilized. The area becomes difficult terrain. Can make a new save at the end of their next turn. Escalation: Can spend 1 additional faez point to increase DC save by 2.

The caster grows two thorny vines that act as separate limbs. These limbs can be used to hold things or be used as a weapon themselves. The caster gains unarmed proficiency for these vines and uses your spell ability for attack bonuses. Damage is 2d6 + spell bonus modifier. Range 10 feet. An attack takes an action. The vines also give the caster advantage on athletics and acrobatics checks. The caster gets an additional free object interaction using their hands. Escalation: Can spend 1 FP during your turn to make a second attack with the vines (Max 1).
Removes the physical and mental effects of alcohol from the caster. Escalation: Can spend 1 point to target someone other than the caster.

The target makes a CHA check, if they fail, they become much more talkative than they would like to be or normally are. As if drunk or as if trying to impress someone. Escalation: Can spend 1 point to target 3 individuals.

A faint ghostly crown forms on your head that only you can see. While the crown is active, you can mentally connect with the Internet to ask questions that would be possible using regular search engines. Only works in places that have active Internet. You also get advantage on all knowledge checks.

Conjure a 30 ft radius field of Veil mist around you. Ask up to 3 questions to spirits or other Veil creatures that may be in the vicinity or tied to the area. Gain advantage on Insight or Occult checks while in the mist. Non-Veil beings in the mist make CHA saving throws at disadvantage while in the mist due to their unease.

Create a realistic sound of thunder in range of the spell. Escalation: Spend 1 Faez Point to increase the volume of the noise, potentially startling anyone not ready for the sound. They must roll a DC CON save or lose their bonus action and halve their speed for the next round.
Give yourself a 10 feet movement bonus, increase in AC by 2, and do not provoke opportunity attacks. As a bonus action, you can move up to your max speed.

A 20’ by 20’ cloud forms around the target area obscuring vision. The cloud is filled with painfully loud thunder that deals 4d6 thunder damage every turn. Casters roll disadvantage on concentration checks while in the cloud. Attempting to move requires a DC CON saving throw or be immobilized for the rest of the turn.
Anticipate a single nearby enemy to give them disadvantage on opportunity attacks and increase your movement speed by 10 feet.

Target makes an INT save, upon a failure, they forget the language of the caster’s choice. This will not affect their spell casting. Escalation: Can spend 1 point each to target another person beyond the first for each point spent.

Target makes a STR save. On a failure, they gain a fly speed of 20 and move erratically for the duration of their turn. They can make another STR save at the end of each of their turns to end the effect. The target will not slam into things and take damage from this spell. The target can still use their actions other than movement as they wish. DM randomly determines the flight path.

Choose a humanoid that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a WIS or STR saving throw or be encoated in a shield of ice for the duration. If incased in ice, the target cannot move or take actions. The target has DR10 at this time and any attacks that deal more than 30 damage will break the encasing. Fire deals damage at double. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make another WIS or STR saving throw. On a success, the spell ends on the target. Escalation: Can spend 1 point each to target another person beyond the first for each point spent.

A faint mist covers the caster making them hard to detect even by observant foes (other people see a streaking mist moving across the room that they can’t explain). The caster moves in lightly obscured mist, roll advantage on stealth checks, and if hitting an enemy with a melee attack without being detected, the target takes damage as if they have vulnerability. Spell attacks from stealth make the target roll at disadvantage for spell saves. If concentration is dropped, the caster still has all these effects for 1 additional turn.

Create a barely visible shimmering shield around your body that gives you an increased AC of 2. When you receive a hit from melee range, you can decide to trigger the shield using a reaction which will deal 2d6 force damage and push the target back by 10 feet.

Duration: 10 minutes or until sprites are gone
Description: The caster gains five force sprites that float around them in a protective barrier. Each sprite gives 1 AC for a total of 5 AC upon casting. For each time the caster is missed by an attack that would have hit, they lose 1 sprite and their AC goes down by 1.

Target Veil being must make a DC WIS spell save. On a success, they take 2d6 spirit damage and cannot move for 1 round. On a failure, they take 2d6 spirit damage and are incapacitated until the spell ends. At the beginning of additional turns, they take 2d6 spirit damage. At the end of additional turns they may roll another save.

Target electrical object is trapped with a magical explosive that will detonate when triggered. The trigger is given when the spell is cast and must be a simple trigger (when touched by a human, after 1 hour, etc.). The explosion deals 4d6 electrical damage with DC Dex save for half damage.

Target enemy must make a DC CON save or become forcibly transformed while the spell is active. A save deals 2d8 fire damage but no transformation. On failure, the target begins to transform and is incapacitated and takes 2d8 fire damage each turn. The targets features turn horrific and if they save before dying, it will take them an equal number of turns to turn back to their original form, taking 2d8 fire damage each time.

Target enemy must make a DC CHA saving throw or they will roll a disadvantage on all CHA based saving throws or skill checks while the spell is maintained. If the spell was successful they will be combatantive and stubborn about even the most basic social things. This counts as a charm.

The caster is covered in an aura of flame. The caster gains fire resistance and +2 AC. Any enemy entering a 10 feet radius or starting their turn in the aura takes 2d6 fire damage. The caster may use an opportunity attack to lash out with a flame whip dealing 3d6 fire damage.
Target must make a DC CON save or take 1d6 damage. If the save is failed, caster gains an amount of health equal to the damage. The damage increases by 1d6 at level 6, 10, and 14.

The caster designates four spots on the battlefield within range where soulfire sentinels are created. They look like pale flames that flicker and dance in place. The sentinels create a region of difficult terrain only for enemies in a range of 10 feet radius. During the duration of the spell, as an opportunity attack if the enemy moves past one of the sentinels, the caster can use a reaction to make a ranged attack against any enemy in range of a soulfire sentinel dealing 4d8 fire damage and causing the enemy to end its movement. Soulfire sentinels have an attack range of 10 feet. At any time during the duration, the caster can use an action to detonate a single sentinel dealing 4d8 spirit damage (Dex Save for half) in a 10 ft radius.

Two target enemies within range are now magically adhered. Whenever one or the other moves, the other target must move within them. If there is any distance between them when the spell is cast, the first time they move, they shift together.

Target must make a DC CON save or suffer from rapid painful growth of bone spurs across their body. Causes 6d6 damage, movement reduced by half, and any new CON saves are made at a disadvantage or half damage and no effects on a save.

A song whips around the target turning to bright lights at moments creating a dizzying effect. The target gains DR2 and rolls advantage on spell saves during the spell. Enemies attacking the target must make a DC INT save or take 2d8 air damage. Escalation: Spend 1 FP to add an additional touch target (Max 1).

Target enemy must make a DC CON saving throw. If they save they are not restrained and only take half damage. Target is wrapped in fiery chains that burn them for 5d6 fire damage and they are restrained until they save the spell. They can save again at the end of their next turn. If the chains remain, they take 2d6 fire damage.

Enemies in a 30 ft radius area with less than a total of 50 hit points are gathered together by a set of ghostly chains, pulling them to a spot at the center, and keeping them restrained. There is no save. The caster can maintain the spell for a maximum of 5 rounds. Escalation: Spend 1 Faez Point to add a 1d8 air damage per round.

In a 30 ft sq area, everyone in range must make a DC WIS save or believe that the area around beneath their feet is lava. If they fail, they take 3d6 psychic damage, move as if it’s difficult terrain, and give advantage on all opportunity attacks. They must immediately move out of the lava area by the fastest route possible. If they end their turn in the field, they take 2d6 psychic damage.

The caster creates a 15 ft radius region that draws energy from the Veil. Anyone besides the caster are caught in the area, or passing through it, must roll a DC WIS save or become frightened until they leave the spectral domain. All non-Veil creatures or the caster in the domain take 1d8 spirit damage per turn while they are in the domain. As a bonus action, the caster can move the spectral domain up to 30 feet. Veil creatures in the domain roll attacks and checks at advantage.

A pair of boots form on your feet. You can make them appear as normal boots, or look like they’re made of earth, air, or water, or a mix of the three. The boots give you additional 20 feet of movement, you can ignore plant or natural based difficult terrain, double your jump distance, roll sneak at advantage, and gives you resistance to plant based damage. Additionally, if you’re knocked unconscious, you will shift to a space 30 feet away, and instantly heal 5 hit points, but the boots will disappear and the spell will end. This spell is an aura. You can only have 1 active at a time.

Caster designates a single friendly target to cure of most negative effects. Immobility, speed reduction, or stuns are immediately dispelled. The target immediately gets to save again for each other negative effects. Target is healed 3d8 damage.

Target makes a CON save. On a failure, their mouth is filled with small colorful beans. Target gets another CON save at the end of each of their turns to end the effect. If the target saves on their CON save, and knows the proper combination of finger movements, they may choose to make an INT save, if they succeed at this, they may cast this spell on another target of their choice and the duration restarts.

Caster creates a 20 ft radius patch of magical darkness that only they can see through. Any enemies in the darkness are blind and must roll a DC INT save to move at half speed (or immobilized if fail). The affected creature treats ranged targets as if they are in total cover. Escalation: Spend 1 FP to increase the radius by 10 feet (Max 1).

In your fist, a magical ghostly truncheon forms that vibrates with dangerous energy. The twisted club cannot be removed from your hand unless you wish it. You gain proficiency with the weapon and +2 to hit. It deals 2d6+2 damage and they must roll a DC CON save or become frightened. Once saved, the weapon cannot affect them for 24 hours. Caster may spend 1 Faez Point to make a second attack during the round.

Target enemy must either stay stationary, or move their entire movement in a straight line. If they have multiple attacks, a single miss means all attacks miss. If someone attacks the cursed target with multiple attacks, a single hit means all attacks hit.

Target unconscious humanoid is placed in a protective force shield that gives them 4 AC, a damage shield of 30 hit points, and slowly begins healing them 1 hit point per round. They will not regain consciousness until they have more than 10 hit points and will not be freed from the protective shell until they are at full hit points, the caster dismisses it, or they damage the shell from the inside.

A figure made of spirit motes in a shape of the casters discretion appears and guards the player until it destroyed or the duration runs out. Its HP are half the casters and it uses the caster’s reaction to impose disadvantage on any creature attacking the player within 30 feet. Half of any damage dealt to the player is prevented and taken instead by the guardian. Damage prevented this way is dealt back to the attacker.

The caster is healed 1d6 damage, receives a temporary shield of 1d4 hit points, can move up to 30 feet as a bonus action, gains +4AC until the end of the next round, and creates a 5 ft radius location of difficult terrain (ice, plants, or rocks).

On a successful ranged attack, the target is dealt 2d6 fire damage, immobilized with ice around their feet (which does not melt from the fire) for 1 round, all attacks against it are at advantage for the rest of combat, pushed back 10 feet (optional), and take another 2d6 bludgeoning damage.

Caster’s skin raises or lowers to a temperature they find most pleasing. There is a nice tingling feeling like the skin has been recently exfoliated. Any adverse temperature or weather causes this spell to fail

Caster holds a ceramic mug, or pieces of a broken ceramic mug, speaks the spells incantation and the mug is completely fixed. A small, stylized ‘R’ forms on the bottom of the mug etched into the ceramic.

Choose a sound-related focus (speaker of some sort) then choose a 20ft radius area. The next time an entity makes sound in the chosen area, a sound file will be listenable on the sound-related focus chosen. This sound file duration is as long as the entity is making noise within the area up to 10 minutes. Escalation: Can spend one point to increase audio sensitivity or create audio for next 10 unique entities.

Choose a visual focus (glass ball, unpowered screen, etc) then choose a point in space and a perspective from that point. The next time an entity crosses through the perspective, an image will be viewable on the visual focus chosen. Escalation: Can spend one point to increase resolution or create image for next 10 unique entities.
The exterior of caster’s body and items carried or worn become completely waterproof.

A protective shimmering shield protects the caster from fire damage. The shield will absorb 10 fire damage before dissipating. After it’s gone, the caster will retain fire resistance for the remainder of the duration.

Target must make a DC STR saving throw or become encased in a dense bubble of water that moves with them. Their movement is half, they cannot make ranged attacks, and they must hold their breath while inside it. Target may make a new saving throw at the end of their turn.
Increase AC by 2 and add 10 temporary hit points.

Call up winds to batter a large or smaller target. The target loses their bonus action, movement is halved, and have to make an DC STR Save or be knocked prone. Any intimidation skill checks versus this opponent are made at advantage for 1 hour afterwards.
Shoot a two bolt of force energy at a target dealing 2d6 damage upon hit (ranged attack) and push target back 5 feet. +2 to hit for both force bolt attacks.

Caster casts a protective ward on their companion which creates a health link between them. Any damage recieved by the companion in the specified range will be transferred to the player. This means that area of effect damage will hit the player double. If the player dies, then the bond is severed.
Caster casts the protective ward on their companion which gives them an increased AC2 and DR2.

Caster casts enhances their companion giving it 10 temporary hit points for high companions, or 4 temporary hit points for low companions. Additionally, the companion receives +2 to attack rolls and +2 AC.

After a small flash of flame and embers, your entire outfit is transformed into a new version that looks any way you want it to. The outfit cannot provide any bonuses that were not already a part of the outfit.
Heal target 2d4+2 damage
Caster gains 3 movement actions this round. Does not provoke attacks of opportunity during this movement.
Caster gains +4 AC versus bullets, DR3 versus bullets, and +2 AC.

If the player would roll a natural 1 for a skill or combat check, that roll is turned into a success. Then the player can change any enemy’s roll into a natural 1 for the rest of the day. Both effects can only happen once per day.

The next spell you cast which may not have a trigger based on a given person or creature now only affects or is triggered by the particular person or creature chosen. Escalation: Can spend one point to increase number of particular people or creatures by one for each point spent.

Choose a sound-related focus (speaker of some sort) then choose a 20ft radius area. The next time an entity makes sound in the chosen area, that sound will be played/amplified through that sound-related focus for 10 minutes. Escalation: Can spend one point to increase audio sensitivity or extend sound being played for full duration of spell.
Caster may take another action this turn.
Reduce crit range for this player by 1.
Heal self 5d6 damage, eliminate any poisons, and give yourself a 10 temporary hit point shield.
For every 10 feet player has moved this turn, add an additional 1d6 air damage to the next attack.
Caster rolls advantage on their next attack, rerolls 1s on damage dice, and if the attack fails to hit the target, they get advantage on their next attack.
Lob an acid blob at target dealing 3d6 upon hit (ranged attack); Target must make a DC CON save or be blinded for 1 round.

Target must make a DC Saving throw or be charmed for 1 minute. A charmed target will not harm anyone or do anything against their will while charmed. The charmed condition will allow the caster to convince the target of accepting normal decisions that don’t directly impact them (ie - forcing a hostess to give them a table at a popular restaurant, telling a guard he has to use the bathroom, etc.) A failed save will make the target hostile to the caster.
Give a length of time, or trigger for when the electrical object or panel will either turn on or off.

When given an opportunity attack, or damaged by an enemy (range 15ft), or an enemy fails a spell save (range 15ft), the caster may hit the target with an acid jet which deals 6d6 fire damage and reduces their movement by half for the rest of their turn.
Create a hole that’s no bigger than 5’ x 5’ on a surface. The material must be wood, concrete, non-metal, or non-magical. The thickness can be no greater than 1 foot.

If the caster is hit with an attack by an adjacent enemy, the enemy makes a DEX save or take 6d6 acid damage. This acid slowly eats away at anything the enemy is holding unless the enemy uses an action to shake off the acid. On a successful save, they take half damage. The enemy has -3 to their AC and -3 to their attack rolls for the next 5 rounds.

Target’s shoes or feet become slippery as if they’ve been coated by grease or ice. Can move across slick surfaces (ice, grease, etc.) at twice normal speed. Or on normal surfaces, at the end of planned movement, the target moves an additional 10 feet in the same direction they’d been moving.

Touch a metal object like a fence, metal structure, or other metal items to electrify it for 10 minutes. Anyone who comes in contact with it during the duration takes 2d6 electrical damage. Targeting a metal object on a living creature will give them a chance to save at advantage to resist the effect. Escalation: Spend an additional 1 FE to increase damage by 1d8.
In a 30 feet arc, blast electricity for 8d8 electrical damage to anyone in range with half damage on a DC DEX save. Escalation: Can spend 1 additional point increase damage by 2d8 (Max 1)

The spell uses all remaining faez, but has a minimum requirement of 2. The caster has absolute advantage on the target. If they hit, the target is restrained for one round and takes 4d6 fire and 4d10 electricity damage on a failed save. A successful save takes half damage and the target is still restrained for one round. Escalation: For every excess faez point spent over 2, it increases damage by 1d6 fire and 1d10 electricity.

The spell uses all remaining faez, but has a minimum requirement of 2. The caster has absolute advantage on the target. If they hit, the target is restrained for one round and takes 4d6 fire and 4d10 electricity damage on a failed save. A successful save takes half damage and the target is still restrained for one round. Escalation: For every excess faez point spent over 2, it increases damage by 1d6 fire and 1d10 electricity.

Designate a 5’x5’ square within range that is invisible to everyone except the caster and their allies. If a creature moves into the designated space, they trigger the trap and are thrown in the direction they are currently moving. The target is thrown 40ft plus any distance they’ve already moved in an arc.
Target window or other see-through object becomes tinted or obscured making it no longer see-through.
A flaming spear is hurled at the target and upon hit (ranged attack) takes 3d8 fire damage. Target takes 1d6 fire damage every turn after for 3 rounds.

A field of 30’ by 30’ grows rocky spikes that pierce flesh and create havoc. Anyone caught in the field must make a DEX save or take 4d6 piercing and 4d6 fire damage (save takes half damage). Anyone moving through the field takes 1d6 fire damage for every 10 feet traveled. The field is difficult terrain for as long as the spell is active. Escalation: Can spend 1 additional point to increase piercing and fire damage by 1d6 (Max 1)

Base Armor Class becomes 18 but DEX AC bonus no longer applies. Caster has fire resistance. Enemies that begin their turn within 10 feet take 2d6 fire damage. Each turn as a bonus action make a ranged attack against an enemy within 30 feet for 3d6 fire damage.

Caster causes the touched item to miraculously, although not instantaneously, change into something else. The original item and transformed item must be similar sizes, values, and states of matter. The maximum number of rounds for cast time is 4. Escalation: For 1 FP the caster can increase the number of rounds by 1 (Max: 2)

All electronic lights in range of the spell create a powerful flash that blinds anyone who did not have their eyes closed. Anyone in range must roll a Dex save or be blinded. Can reroll at the end of the next turn.

Target must make a DC CHA save or become soul scorched. Failure to save takes 8d8 spirit damage and cannot heal for the next 4 rounds. Success takes half damage. Escalation: Spend 1 FP to increase damage by 2d8 (Max 1)

At the target location, a force explosion will deal 6d6 force damage to everyone in a 20’ x 20’ area and knock them prone if they fail a DC DEX save. Damage cut in half if they make a DC CON save. Escalation: Spend 1 FP to increase damage by 2d6.

Caster uses faez to anchor their soul to their body. If the caster were to fall to 0 hit points during the duration, instead they fall to 1 hp instead and gain these benefits: Any creature starting their turn within 10 feet of the caster take 2d6 fire damage. The caster has 2 actions on their turn for 3 rounds. At the beginning of each of the caster’s turns, they gain 15 temporary hit points for the next 3 turns. The caster gets a brief insight into the future causing them to know how their enemies will act and react. Attacks the caster makes until the end of their next turn have Perfect Advantage. Attacks made against the caster until the end of their next turn are made with Perfect Disadvantage.

Caster’s shoes or feet cause water to freeze underneath them enough to support the caster’s weight. Water thaws at normal rate when caster is no longer standing on that spot. Water only freezes fast enough for caster to move 20ft per round. Escalation: Spend 1 more FE to be able to move safely on the ice at full speed.
When hit damaged by an attack, heal 3d4 damage and move away from the attacker 15 feet.
Increase speed by 50 feet for one round, move to a target, and make two melee attacks.

Target enemy is coated in a sheen of glistening ice. They take 2d4 cold damage every turn. If they choose to move (forced movement doesn’t count), the ice hardens around them. For every 10 feet of movement, more ice forms on their body and they take another 2d4 cold damage and must make a DC CON save or become incapacitated. Once incapacitated, they may make a new save at the end of each of their turns. The spell only goes away if concentration is broken or the target is unconscious.

Designate a 5’x5’ square within range that is invisible to everyone except the caster and their allies.. If a creature moves into the designated space, they trigger the trap and must make a DC DEX save or their speed becomes 0, they take 4d6 cold damage, and make all checks at disadvantage until the end of the next round.

The caster causes a willing creature’s body to become incredibly malleable and light. They gain a fly speed of 60 feet. The target has resistance to non-magical damage, can occupy the space of another creature, can pass through a 2 inch by 2 inch hole. If the target is aloft and were to fall, they descend slowly enough to take no fall damage.

Range: 1 medium creature, 3 small creatures, or 8 tiny creatures
Description: Tame a non-intelligent creature for 1 minute. The animal will only do a few simple things: move away, stand still, or follow me. Escalation: For 1 each additional FP point, include 1 additional medium (or corresponding smaller numbers)
A 10 foot radius area of earth (not stone) or water (not ice) becomes thick mud. Escalation: Can spend one point to increase radius to 30 foot.

The caster grows two thorny vines that act as separate limbs. These limbs can be used to hold things or be used as a weapon themselves. The caster gains unarmed proficiency for these vines and uses your spell ability for attack bonuses. Damage is 2d6 + spell bonus modifier. Range 10 feet. An attack takes an action. The vines also give the caster advantage on athletics and acrobatics checks. The caster gets an additional free object interaction using their hands. Escalation: Can spend 1 FP during your turn to make a second attack with the vines (Max 1).
You are able to use your mastery over earth and water to drill a 5x5 tunnel 15 feet into mundane stone. Escalation: Can spend one point to increase to 25 feet.

The caster can create a 15 foot radius dome of protection as a reaction in response to a damaging spell, or damaging environmental effect (like a building collapse, avalanche, etc.). All magical damage is reduced by half. All physical effects are blocked by the dome (ie - a mud slide would go around the dome, or falling rocks would bounce off harmlessly). The dome lasts until the beginning of the caster’s next turn.

Caster touches a nearby plant, using faez to release its latent natural fury. The plant creature acts at initiative count 14 and either protects the caster or attacks the same targets as the caster to the best of its ability. AC 12, HP 127, Speed 20, Climb 20, STR 14, DEX 14, CON 16, INT 5, WIS 14, CHA 3, Immune to Blindness and Deafness, Blindsight 120ft, Spider Climb, Multiattack - On its turn, the plant can make 3 attacks - Tentacle +5, reach 10ft, 2d6+2 bludgeoning damage, target must succeed on a DC 14 Con save or take 3d6 poison damage.

2 Tentacles emerge from the caster’s back. These tentacles can make unarmed attacks, lift up to 50 lbs each, squeeze through small holes, help a character climb, and help grapple. There’s also the visual aspect that may affect others.
Target can see through basic illusions easily like Look Away enchantments. Escalation: Increase targets by 1.

Conjure a 30 ft radius field of Veil mist around you. Ask up to 3 questions to spirits or other Veil creatures that may be in the vicinity or tied to the area. Gain advantage on Insight or Occult checks while in the mist. Non-Veil beings in the mist make CHA saving throws at disadvantage while in the mist due to their unease.

The caster steps into the Veil for 1 round. They will return from the Veil at the beginning of their next turn. While they’re in the Veil, they are completely protected from Veil beings, and during their jaunt, they heal 5d6 damage and have advantage on their next save (within 10 rounds). Escalation: Can spend 1 FP to increase the round spent in the Veil (Max 1).

As a reaction, caster may give an ally within range absolute advantage for an attack roll or ability check. Alternatively, as a reaction, caster may give an enemy within range absolute disadvantage for an attack roll or ability check. Escalation: Can spend 1 FP to make it work for spell saves.

You create a large-sized swirling cyclone of wind, dust, and dirt. Any individual within the same area of the Dust Devil must make a Strength save or be pushed out of it. Any items weighing less than 5 pounds will be blown about. Any ranged attacks made through the Dust Devil’s space is made at disadvantage and as if there were three-quarters cover. As a bonus action on your turn, you may move the Dust Devil up to 15 feet. Escalation: Can spend one point to increase size to huge.
You gain +2 to initiative, cannot be surprised, +2 AC, and 10 feet of additional movement.

A 30’ by 30’ cloud forms around the target area obscuring vision. The cloud is filled with painfully loud thunder that deals 6d6 thunder damage every turn. Casters roll disadvantage on concentration checks while in the cloud. Attempting to move requires a DC CON saving throw or be immobilized for the rest of the turn.

Air pressure within a patch of ground erupts causing damage and havoc. You choose a point within 60 feet of you. The ground within a 20 foot radius becomes difficult terrain. Any individuals in the range roll a Dex check or are dealt 8d6 thunder damage and are pushed 10 feet. A success reduces the damage by half but does not negate the movement. (2nd STR save for no movement + full damage). Escalation: Can spend one point to increase damage to 10d6.
Their crit range reduces by 1 and spell DC increases by 1. While the aura is active and the caster is below 50% health, any damage dice for a particular spell can be rerolled once.

The caster gains 20 feet additional movement until their next successful attack. The caster gains Perfect Advantage on their next singe-target attack. On their next successful singe-target attack, the caster adds 4d10 wind damage and the target is pushed 20 feet. If this movement causes the enemy to move into a hard surface, the enemy take 1d6 bludgeoning damage for each 10 feet of movement before impact.
Make a ranged attack versus the target at advantage. If it hits, the target takes 3d8 damage and rolls all attacks at disadvantage on its next round.

A swirling dust devil captures the target, forcing a DC STR saving throw or they’re immobilized, cannot take bonus actions, and must make a DC CON save to take any actions. They get a saving throw at the end of every round.

An inanimate object, which could include a dead body, reveals any recent spells that affected it. The elements from the magics can be revealed as well as the originator of the spell if they are within 120 feet. This information is available for 24 hours.

A faint mist covers the caster making them hard to detect even by observant foes (other people see a streaking mist moving across the room that they can’t explain). The caster moves in lightly obscured mist, roll advantage on stealth checks, and if hitting an enemy with a melee attack without being detected, the target takes damage as if they have vulnerability. Spell attacks from stealth make the target roll at disadvantage for spell saves. If concentration is dropped, the caster still has all these effects for 1 additional turn.

Upon casting, they must choose a single element to intensify. The caster creates 3 elemental nodes spaced within the range of the spell. Each node multiplies the effects of that chosen element within 10 feet. Spell damage within the range increase damage dice by 2 dice. Spell DC increases by 2. As a bonus action, the caster can move 1 elemental node up to 20 feet. The elemental nodes look like representations of their element in a floating bubble.
While this aura is active, the caster’s allies within 20 feet gain a +2 bonus to spell save DCs. Escalation: Can spend 1 FP to increase duration to 8 hours.

A privacy bubble forms around you in a radius up to 10 feet. The bubble creates a shimmering field which blocks sound and obscures vision so lip reading or other tale-tell markers of communication cannot be observed.
Two stones are enchanted as magical walkie-talkies that cannot be evesdropped upon. The range of the communication is up to 1 mile. Escalation: Spend 1 point to increase number of stones by 2.
Target gains a +2 AC versus bullets and a DR2 versus bullets.

Target Veil being must make a DC WIS spell save. On a success, they take 3d6 spirit damage and cannot move for 1 round. On a failure, they take 3d6 spirit damage and are incapacitated until the spell ends. At the beginning of additional turns, they take 3d6 spirit damage. At the end of additional turns they may roll another save.
Target gains a +4 AC versus bullets and a DR4 versus bullets.

The target must make a DC CHA saving throw or lose themselves in an illusion of the casters making. While they are in the Hall of Mirrors, the caster is deciding what the target is seeing. If they take damage, or something significantly physical happens that is contradictory to the illusion, the target gets another saving throw. If the transition from normal to illusion is jarring, or inconsistent, then the target gets to make all rolls at advantage.

An enchantment is place on the location with a trigger. Upon the trigger, the faez in the enchantment springs from the location attempting to entrap one target. The target gets a Dexterity save. Upon failure, the target is trapped and shrunken into a cage 2 feet tall by 1 foot wide. The spell creates a demi-realm where the trapped individual is but looking into the cage shows them in a way that they look shrunken. The spell can be recast to keep the target in the cage for an hour. The trapped individual gets a save with each new spell cast.
Touch a door or other movable barrier (gate, window, etc.). For the duration of the spell, the barrier is magically locked. This doesn’t prevent breaking or bypassing by other means.

While this aura is active, the caster gains +1 to hit and damage for spells. If they kill an enemy with a spell they gain an extra action for free. While this aura is active they may also use a bonus action to add +2 to their AC until the beginning of the next round.

Target enemy must make a DC CON save or become forcibly transformed while the spell is active. A save deals 3d8 fire damage but no transformation. On failure, the target begins to transform and is incapacitated and takes 3d8 fire damage each turn. The targets features turn horrific and if they save before dying, it will take them an equal number of turns to turn back to their original form, taking 3d8 fire damage each time.

The caster designates a spot within range where a field of grotesque three-fingered claws rise from the ground in a 25 foot radius. All those caught within the field must make a DC DEX save or become grappled. Moving through the field requires double movement (which is not difficult terrain, so if also difficult terrain, then it’s a quarter movement). If a creature begins their turn in the field they take 5d6 fire damage and must make a DC CON save or be poisoned.

Touch an individual plant to make it grow rapidly over a 10 minute period. The plant will become more lush, provide fruit or other outputs, and be radically healthy. Alternatively, a section of plants no larger than 5’ by 10’ can be touched and they will grow over a 1 week period providing the same benefits.

Target enemy must make a DC WIS save or become magically linked to the caster. While the linkage is active, the target takes 2d6 damage, loses 2 AC, and -1 to hit. While the linkage is active, the caster gains 2d6 health, a bonus of 2 AC, and a +1 to hit. The linkage lasts until target or caster is dead, or the distance between the two is greater than 100 feet.

The caster is covered in an aura of flame. The caster gains fire resistance and +2 AC. Any enemy entering a 10 feet radius or starting their turn in the aura takes 2d6 fire damage. The caster may use an opportunity attack to lash out with a flame whip dealing 3d6 fire damage.

Target inanimate object less than 5 tons and smaller than a one story ranch house is subjected to arcane forces that attempt to rip it apart. The object must make a DC STR save or be torn apart, making it unusable. If the object is larger than the required weights and sizes it makes a save at advantage and only the portion that meets the requirement will be affected. If anyone is caught within the structure (small house, car, etc.) they will take 8d8+10 crushing damage.
Touch a container of food or water no more than 5lbs. They are cleansed of any poisons, or other minor corruptions. The food or water will also taste better and have improved nutrition.
When drinking a potion, caster may use this spell as a reaction to eliminate one aftereffect.

The caster designates four spots on the battlefield within range where soulfire sentinels are created. They look like pale flames that flicker and dance in place. The sentinels create a region of difficult terrain only for enemies in a range of 10 feet radius. During the duration of the spell, as an opportunity attack if the enemy moves past one of the sentinels, the caster can use a reaction to make a ranged attack against any enemy in range of a soulfire sentinel dealing 5d8 fire damage and causing the enemy to end its movement. Soulfire sentinels have an attack range of 15 feet. At any time during the duration, the caster can use an action to detonate a single sentinel dealing 5d8 spirit damage (Dex Save for half) in a 10 ft radius.

The caster and all allies within 20 feet radius of the targeted area are healed 6d8 damage, can roll another save on one negative conditions currently active, and gain advantage on their next attack roll. Escalate: Spend 1 FP to increase radius by 10 feet (Max: 2).

Touch a simple inanimate object used for transport (skateboard, bike, skis, etc.). The object will stay with the caster as long as they wish the object to be near them. All skill checks using the item are rolled at advantage. The caster may use a bonus action to perform a trick with the object. The caster as a free action may also add illusionary sparks or fire to their tricks or general motion.

While this aura is active, you may use your primary attribute for using firearms. While the aura is active, caster can attack twice, instead of once, whenever they use a firearm to take the Attack action on their turn.

A song whips around the target turning to bright lights at moments creating a dizzying effect. The target gains DR3 and rolls advantage on spell saves during the spell. Enemies attacking the target must make a DC INT save or take 3d6 air damage. Escalation: Spend 1 FP to add an additional touch target (Max 1).
Target enemy must make a DC CON save or be stunned for 3 rounds.
Touch the starting mechanism of a machine like a car, bus, or other transportation vehicle. The caster can start or stop the vehicle without losing the spell for the duration.
For the duration of the spell, all allies within range gain a +2 to all checks related to rituals. Escalation: Increase duration to 1 hour.

Enemies in a 30 ft radius area with less than a total of 80 hit points are gathered together by a set of ghostly chains, pulling them to a spot at the center, and keeping them restrained. There is no save. The caster can maintain the spell for a maximum of 6 rounds. Escalation: Spend 1 Faez Point to add a 1d8 air damage per round.

The caster creates a 20 ft radius region that draws energy from the Veil. Anyone besides the caster are caught in the area, or passing through it, must roll a DC WIS save or become frightened until they leave the spectral domain. All non-Veil creatures or the caster in the domain take 3d6 spirit damage per turn while they are in the domain. As a bonus action, the caster can move the spectral domain up to 30 feet. Veil creatures in the domain roll attacks and checks at advantage.

The item touched must be natural and translucent. Amber, amethyst, jewels, obsidian, etc would work. As the spell is cast, a specific individual is named. When the individual is within 30 feet of the item warded, the item glows.
Touch a non-aggressive Veil creature to magically calm it and make it more amiable to questions or persuasion. Roll at advantage for checks

While this aura is active, the caster gains +1 to hit and damage for melee weapons that they are proficient. If they kill an enemy using a weapon they are proficient with they gain an extra action for free. While this aura is active they may also use a bonus action to shift up to 15 feet without provoking an opportunity attack.

Shoot 3 rays from your finger at a +2 bonus to hit. Must hit a target with a ranged spell attack to succeed. Each ray deals 4d10 lightning damage. Upon a successful hit, the target must make a DC STR save or be pushed back 5 feet. Three successful hits on the same target will stun them until the end of their next turn. Escalation: Spend 1 FP to change the cast time to bonus action.

When the aura is cast, designate an elemental type. This aura extends in a 20 feet radius around the caster. All damage from that element is reduced by half which includes environmental damage (if they’re near a river of lava, then the aura would help protect from the heat and fire).
Touch a non-electronic or non-magical lock and open or close it. Escalation: Spend 1 FP to open or close an electronic or magical lock.

While this aura is active, you may use your primary attribute for using melee weapons. While the aura is active, caster can attack twice, instead of once, whenever they use a melee weapon to take the Attack action on their turn.

Caster designates a single friendly target to cure of most negative effects. Immobility, speed reduction, or stuns are immediately dispelled. The target immediately gets to save again for each other negative effects. Target is healed 5d8 damage.

The caster gains DR2, +2 to AC, and an additional 40 feet of movement until the beginning of their next turn. An iron carapace forms on the front of their body. If they charge a thin inanimate object (wooden door, chain link fence, concrete less than 1 inch, etc) after moving at least 10 feet, they will break through to the other side and can continue moving if they choose. Thicker objects will require a DC STR save starting at DC 14 and going all the way to DC 30 for a three inch thick metal wall. If the caster charges a living object, they must roll to hit. On a successful hit, they’ll do 3d6 plus damage equal to double their AC to the target.

Touch a simple inanimate object. For the duration of the spell and as long as the caster is within 1 mile, the caster can see through the object. Whenever the object is being actively looked through, a flicker of an “eye” can be seen on the object if being directly looked upon. Escalation: Spend 1 FP to increase duration to 4 hours.

Summon two jackal-headed warriors made of shadow that will fight for you. They can receive basic instructions (fight, defend, find, etc.). See Shadow Warrior in Friends & Foes. Escalation: Spend 1 additional FP to make a third shadow warrior.

Caster creates a 30 ft radius patch of magical darkness that only they can see through. Any enemies in the darkness are blind and must roll a DC INT save to move at half speed (or immobilized if fail). The affected creature treats ranged targets as if they are in total cover. Escalation: Spend 1 FP to increase the radius by 10 feet (Max 1).

When hit by a spell, the caster can cast rebound as a reaction. Both mages must make a contested roll using their best ability stat. If the caster of rebound wins the roll, the spell returns to and hits the original caster and causes no effects to the caster of rebound. A failed contested roll causes the original spell to function as normal.

Touch a deck of cards, set of dice, or other random game playing tools while mentally indicating the desired result. For the duration of the spell, the desired result will occur three times more often than normal.
While this aura is active, the caster doesn’t get actions, but can use 3 bonus actions instead. Bonus action spells while the aura is active have a reduced FP cost of 1 but cannot go lower than 1.

Target enemy must either stay stationary, or move their entire movement in a straight line. If they have multiple attacks, a single miss means all attacks miss. If someone attacks the cursed target with multiple attacks, a single hit means all attacks hit.

Duration: Instant / until 3 successive turns without damage
Description: Target enemy gains a curse which creates a demise counter. The demise counter starts at one. At the beginning of the target’s turn, they take spirit damage equal to the demise counter and then the counter increases by one. If the target takes damage from a single source, the demise counter goes up by two (multiple rays from the same spell each count as a source). If the demise counter is above five, the target has disadvantage on all saves. If the demise counter is above ten, they lose 4 AC. All demise counters and the curse will go away if the target doesn’t take damage for 3 successive turns.

Touch an inanimate non-magical object. For the duration of the spell, any attempts to magically control it requires a contested roll which notifies the caster of the attempt and who is trying to take control. This spell works within a 5 mile radius.
Plants in the range of the spell can offer information about anything that happened in the area for the last 24 hours.

A figure made of spirit motes in a shape of the casters discretion appears and guards the player until it destroyed or the duration runs out. Its HPs are three-fourths the casters and it uses the caster’s reaction to impose disadvantage on any creature attacking the player within 30 feet. Half of any damage dealt to the player is prevented and taken instead by the guardian. Damage prevented this way is dealt back to the attacker.

The spell creates 5 star motes which each increase AC by 1. As a free action, the caster can extinguish one mote to give themselves advantage on a save, heal themselves 3d8 damage, or prevent a critical.

Calm a creature (beast, monstrosity, animal) not to attack or flee. Must be CR less than player level minus two. Any damage to the creature will end the effect. Escalation: Spend 1 point to increase CR by 2 (can spend multiple)

Create a magical force shield up to 10 feet away from the caster. If shield is near self, then add +4 AC. If further away, then the shield may stop forward movement of small creature that runs into it. Escalation: Spend 1 point to increase size of creature stopped by one level.
Increase speed by 30 feet per round. Escalation: Spend 1 point to change cast time to a reaction upon being attacked in melee.
Target must make a save against WIS DC check or be stunned for 1 round. Escalation: Spend 1 point to increase DC by 2 (can spend multiple)
Target must make a save against WIS DC check or be stunned for 1 round and take 1d8 force damage. Escalation: Spend 1 point to increase DC by 2 and damage by 1d8 force damage (can spend multiple)
If the target has fallen below zero hit points, or has died within the last minute, the mark of the phoenix will bring them back to 10 hit points.
Your fingernails grow into razor sharp blades that can cut objects or flesh easily. Unarmed attacks become 1d6 slashing.

Requirement: Water 3, Fire 3, WIS 12, or AURA HEALERS
Description: Heal target 2d4 damage. Escalation: Spend 1 FP to increase healing by 2d4.

Requirement: Aura Healers OR WIS 15, Water 5, Spirit 4
Description: Any healing spell you cast gains an additional 1d4 of healing

Requirement: Aura Healers OR WIS 15, Water 5, Spirit 4
Description: Any ally within 30 feet rolls 1d4 for WIS checks

Requirement: Aura Healers OR WIS 15, Water 5, Spirit 4
Description: Roll advantage on any grapple checks

The caster turns a small metal object with a flat surface like a coin, or toaster into a miniature screen that will display what an invisible eye can see. The invisible eye can be placed within 30 feet of the caster and will move with them, and can be relocated at any time during the duration.
Touch a building or house electrical outlet and completely shut down all electricity in range from the touch location for the duration of the spell.

Requirement: Air 7, Earth 2 Dex 15, or Stone Singers

Choose a visual focus (glass ball, unpowered screen, etc) then choose a point in space and a perspective from that point. The next time an entity crosses through the perspective, a ‘video’ will be viewable on the visual focus chosen. This video’s duration is as long as the entity is moving within the perspective up to 10 minutes. Escalation: Can spend one point to increase resolution or create image for next 10 unique entities.

Choose a visual focus (glass ball, unpowered screen, etc) then choose a point in space and a perspective from that point. The two recipients of the bond are linked by the sigil for the duration of the spell. They can pass messages, sense what’s happening to the other, and any damage they take is shared equally between the two.

A sigil is drawn onto the flesh which quickly turns invisible once the spell is complete. The sigil gives the character +2 perception, +2 initiative, and advantage on rolls for skill checks during combat.

A sigil is placed on a location no larger than 10’ x 10’ that cannot be seen with the naked eye. The sigil can be detected using faez or other detection methods. If the “trigger” is met, then the sigil explodes for 4d8 force damage in a 20 ft radius. The trigger must be a condition that the spell can understand (ie - When Bob Morehouse walks over the Sigil, or if a demon walks over the Sigil, etc.)

The targeted area is surrounded by ghostly runes. If any individual crosses the threshold, the caster will be mentally notified. Escalation: Can spend 1 additional point to increase the duration to 24 hours.

The caster or area is surrounded by ghostly runes. Anyone who enters the area or makes a successful attack against the protected individual makes a strength save. On a failure, they are dealt 1d10 of ice damage and pushed away 10 feet. On a success, they are not pushed away. Escalation: Can spend 1 additional point increase damage by 1d10. Escalation: Can spend 1 additional to target an individual other than the caster.

The caster or area is surrounded by ghostly runes. Anyone who enters the area or makes a successful attack against the protected individual makes a dexterity save. On a failure, they are dealt 1d10 of fire damage and set on fire. On a success, they are not on fire. When on fire, they may use an action to put the flames out. Each turn they end while on fire, they take 2d6 fire damage. Escalation: Can spend 1 additional point increase the initial damage by 1d10. Escalation: Can spend 1 additional to target an individual other than the caster.

The targeted area looks slightly askew in regard to its actual interior. Targeting attacks made that pass through the boundary are made at disadvantage. Escalation: Can spend 1 additional point to increase the duration to 24 hours.

The caster looks slightly askew. Ranged attacks are made at disadvantage. Escalation: Can spend 1 additional point to increase the duration to 1 hour. Escalation: Can spend 1 additional to target an individual other than the caster.
